tools.name: get_top_rates
tools.description: Return top SwitchWize rates for a supported category with freshness and attribution metadata.

tools.name: get_top_hysa_rates
tools.description: Return top high-yield savings rates with freshness and attribution metadata.

tools.name: get_bank_gap
tools.description: Estimate the annual savings gap for a balance using the current Bank Gap Index assumptions.

tools.name: compare_switch_savings
tools.description: Compare a user's current APY with SwitchWize's current top savings APY for a balance.

tools.name: get_rate_freshness
tools.description: Return public data source freshness status and affected routes.

tools.name: get_index_dataset
tools.description: Return a SwitchWize index dataset summary and recent series.

tools.name: get_bank_gap_index
tools.description: Return the current SwitchWize Bank Gap Index headline value, latest release, and methodology URL.

tools.name: get_reality_score
tools.description: Return a premium credit-card Reality Score for a card and consumer segment.

tools.name: get_card_offers
tools.description: Return current credit-card welcome-bonus offers (non-targeted, confidence-gated), each with a verified timestamp, source URL, and the card's own 12-month best.

tools.name: get_transfer_bonuses
tools.description: Return current point-transfer bonuses across tracked bank-to-partner routes, each with a verified timestamp, source URL, and best-ever-for-route when real history exists.

tools.name: get_card_changes
tools.description: Return recent verified credit-card fee and APR changes, most recent first. Each event is a diff between two confirmed snapshots of the same card.

tools.name: get_reward_valuations
tools.description: Return SwitchWize points/miles valuations (cents per point) per reward currency, with sample size and provisional/published status.

tools.name: best_move_this_week
tools.description: Given the credit cards a user holds, rank this week's dollar-valued actions: which held card to use per spend category, welcome offers at a 12-month high on cards not held, active transfer bonuses, and (optionally) the savings-rate move beside the card move.

tools.name: get_cd_rollover_rules
tools.description: Return verified CD rollover rules for one bank, or every bank SwitchWize has verified: what happens automatically at maturity if the customer does nothing, the grace period, how to stop the rollover, and the early-withdrawal penalty.
